title: The kf_socre is always None
body: i found the kf_socre in always  none in sam2_base.py/_prepare_memory_conditioned_features, maybe the kf_socre mean kf_ious (but not compact to "current_out" in sam2_vidio_predictor.py/_run_single_frame_inference)?
author: txzhou-hust

comments.body:
@InfluenceFunction  Thank you for pointing this out!

We double check out implementation/commit history and found out this two lines should be added to `_run_single_frame_inference` in the `sam2_video_predictor.py` file (which is somehow mistaken during refactoring of the code):
```
        # object pointer is a small tensor, so we always keep it on GPU memory for fast access
        obj_ptr = current_out["obj_ptr"]
        object_score_logits = current_out["object_score_logits"]
        best_iou_score = current_out["best_iou_score"]
        best_kf_score = current_out["kf_ious"]                                             # this line
        # make a compact version of this frame's output to reduce the state size
        compact_current_out = {
            "maskmem_features": maskmem_features, # (B, C, H, W)
            "maskmem_pos_enc": maskmem_pos_enc, 
            "pred_masks": pred_masks,
            "obj_ptr": obj_ptr,
            "object_score_logits": object_score_logits,
            "best_iou_score": best_iou_score,
            "kf_score": best_kf_score,                                                   # and this line
        }
```

Please try to see in the updated version works, thank you!
ok，thank you, i have no other question

satisfaction_conditions: Identification of the correct relationship between kf_score and kf_ious variables
Clear explanation of what code changes are needed to fix the issue
Acknowledgment that there was a mistake in the code during refactoring
